title: Untangling the Nuclear Knot: A Constructive Agenda for Managing China’s Nuclear Relations with the United States and Its Allies
gist: Tong Zhao argues US-China nuclear competition is driven by perception gaps and doctrinal ambiguity (PLA conditional first-use signaling, US damage-limitation and Golden Dome), producing a self-reinforcing spiral where China can outscale the US nuclear production base. He proposes reciprocal NFU/theater-force transparency, defining destabilizing missile defense, FOBS/space restraint, and warns of rising South Korean and Japanese nuclear hedging, citing the May 2026 Trump-Xi 'strategic stability' pledge as an opening.
